'''''P3''''' was one of three [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvettes]] that was sent by [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] to reinforce [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]]'s [[Phoenix Cell|unit]] of the rebellion.<ref name="Princess on Lothal" /> ''P3'' could be identified by its distinctive faded [[Color|yellow]] and orange markings.<ref name="A Princess on Lothal Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/a-princess-on-lothal-episode-guide|text="A Princess on Lothal" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}}</ref>

==History==
Prior to the [[Galactic Civil War]], the [[Starship|ship]] designated ''P3'' was dispatched by [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]], along with the ''[[P1]]'' and ''[[P2]]'', to reinforce [[Phoenix Cell]], a unit of the Rebellion led by [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]]. As a ruse to allay suspicion from the [[Galactic Empire]] of Organa's rebel allegiance, it was arranged to have the three ships stolen. The [[Spectres]], a cell under Sato's command, apprehended the three ships during a [[Mission on Lothal|raid]] on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]].<ref name="Princess on Lothal" />

[[File:HammerheadCorvetteP3-2-BMF86.png|thumb|250px|left|Starboard profile view of ''P3'']]
Some time after her acquisition by the Phoenix fleet, ''P3'' was attacked somewhere in space by the former [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]], who was seeking to [[Maul's capture of the Ghost crew|capture]] the [[Spectres|crew]] of the ''[[Ghost]]''. Maul inflicted heavy damage to the [[corvette]] and boarded her. Despite the crew putting up a considerable fight, they were no match for Maul and were all [[Death|killed]] apart from one [[pilot]] and an [[astromech droid]] whom Maul forced to send a distress call to the ''Ghost'' before capturing them upon arrival. Maul then left the damaged corvette floating in space to be discovered by [[Ezra Bridger]] and [[Kanan Jarrus]], who subsequently discovered the injured pilot and the identity of the attacker.<ref name="Holocrons of Fate">{{Rebels|The Holocrons of Fate}}</ref>

''P3'' was soon repaired and ready for battle once more, however, participating in the Battle of Atollon against the Seventh Fleet. Though one of her sisters, ''P2'', was destroyed in the battle, ''P3'' and her other sister ''P1'' managed to retreat back to Chopper Base and was ultimately one of the few rebel ships to successfully escape, jumping to Yavin 4.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:P3_BTS.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Concept artwork of P3]]
The hammerhead corvette ''P3'' made its first appearance in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|Season Two]] episode "[[A Princess on Lothal]]."<ref name="Princess on Lothal" /> It was revealed as ''P3'' in the Concept Art section of the A Princess on Lothal episode guide.<ref name="Art Gallery APOL">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/a-princess-on-lothal-concept-art-gallery|text="A Princess on Lothal" Concept Art Gallery}}</ref> ''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' identifies the three corvettes by name as ''Lightmaker'', ''Duchess Senna'' and ''Amity's Arrow'', although it has not been clarified which name corresponds to each of the ships.<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref> The ''[[Lightmaker]]'',<ref name="Rogue One Novel">[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]]</ref> which was also seen in ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> has markings nearly identical to ''P1'' which would indicate that P3 is either ''Duchess Senna'' or ''Amity's Arrow''.
